SECL-2582{{tt|*|Regular Edition}} |tracks=10 |colorscheme=Galar}} '''Pokémon the Movie: Koko Theme Song Collection''' (Japanese: '''「劇場版ポケットモンスター　ココ」テーマソング集''') is a Japanese album that was released in Japan on December 23, 2020. It features ten songs by [[Taiiku Okazaki]]: six songs from the [[M23|twenty-third movie]], and four songs from ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]'' as bonus tracks. The Limited Edition includes a DVD featuring trailers, music videos, and creditless opening and ending footage, and a {{TCG ID|S-P Promo|Plump Musician|119}} {{Trading Card Game}} card. ==Tracklist== ===CD=== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{colorschemelight|Galar}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Galar}}" !
